title: buddleja cordata subsp. ovandensis
intro: Buddleja cordata subsp. ovandensis, commonly known as the Chilean butterfly bush, is a shrub species belonging to the Buddlejaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Buddleja cordata subsp. ovandensis are attributed to its ability to relax the airways, alleviate coughs, and soothe irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
